title: Computer Engineering
credential: Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering degree

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

• B WRIT 134 or ENGL 111, 121, or 131 English Composition
• CSS 132 or 142 or CSE 142 Intro Programming I
• CSS 133 or 143 Intro Programming II
• STMATH 124 Calculus I
• STMATH 125 Calculus II
• STMATH 126 Calculus III
• B PHYS 121 Mechanics
• B PHYS 122 Electromagnetism & Oscillatory Motion
sourceText.degree-completion:
Completion Requirements

Complete all of the following:

Core Courses (65 credits)

• B EE 200 Electric Circuits Lab
• B EE 215 or EE 215 Fundamentals of EE
• B EE 233 Circuit Theory
• B EE 235 Continuous Time Linear Systems
• B EE 271 Digital Circuits and Systems
• B EE 331 Devices and Circuits

• B EE 425 Microprocessor System Design
• CSS 342 Data Structures & Algorithms I
• CSS 343 Data Structures & Algorithms II
• CSS 360 Software Engineering
• CSS 427 Embedded Systems
• CSS 430 Operating Systems
• B ENGR 494 Engineering Design and Innovation
• B ENGR 495 Capstone Project in Engineering I
• B ENGR 496 Capstone Project in Engineering II

College Level English Composition and Writing (15-20 credits) includes program admission prerequisites

• B WRIT 134 Composition or ENGL 111, 121, or 131 English Composition or both B WRIT 132 and 133

• B WRIT 135 Research Writing or Introduction to Technical Writing or ENGL 141

• CSS 301 Technical Writing for Computing Professionals

Mathematics, Natural Sciences, and Programming (55-61 credits) includes program admission prerequisites

• STMATH 124 Calculus I
• STMATH 125 Calculus II
• STMATH 126 Calculus III
• STMATH 207 or MATH 207 Introduction to Differential Equations
• STMATH 208 or MATH 208 Matrix Algebra with Applications
• STMATH 224 or MATH 224 Multivariable Calculus
• STMATH 390 or STAT 390 Probability & Statistics in Engineering

• B CHEM 143/144 or CHEM 142 General Chemistry I w/ Lab

• B PHYS 121 Mechanics
• B PHYS 122 Electromagnetism & Oscillatory Motion

• CSS 132 or 142 or CSE 142 Intro Programming I
• CSS 133 or 143 Intro Programming II

Electives (10 credits)
Electives may be selected from B EE and CSS courses (exclude CSS 340, which is an alternative of CSS 342). All CSS/B EE electives must be at or above the 300 level. Of these credits, 5 credits must be at or above the 400 level. A maximum of 5 credits combined can be CSS or B EE Special Topics courses. A maximum of 5 credits combined can be CSS or B EE Independent Study or Undergraduate Research.
Students must earn a grade of 2.0 in all required courses (please note that some courses may require a higher prerequisite GPA)

Additional Courses - As needed to fulfill University General Education Requirements and to equal 180 credits.

In order to graduate with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering (BSCE) from UW Bothell, students are required to complete a total of 180 credits including the above stated requirements with a cumulative GPA of 2.00 or higher. Students must earn a 2.0 or higher in all courses that are required for the BSCE degree. Students are allowed to transfer a total of 15 credits of EE coursework including cross-campus enrollment, exceptions to this policy must be petitioned. In addition, students must meet all University of Washington Bothell graduation requirements.
